}}{{TIDTOC|embedded}} ==Overview== "AI Bridge Core Board", "V1.1" and "2022.06.30" are silkscreened on SoM board. :"AI Bridge Base Board" and "V1.2 2023-05-26" are silkscreened on carrier board.
===Hardware specification=== *CPU: [[Rockchip]] RK1126 @1.5GHz :SoC: Quad-core ARM (Cortex-A7) :NPU: NPU 2.0 Tops @INT8 *Flash: 8GB (eMMC 5.1) Flash *Memory: 4GB (DDR4) SDRAM *Wi-Fi: [[Realtek]] RTL8723DS :802.11bgn (1T1R) + Bluetooth 4.2 (BLE) *Network: 1x Fast Ethernet (100M) port *Power Source: 5V/2A via USB (Type-C)
